item.description: The Big Walk for Young Warriors is officially underway in Rehoboth today. item.title: Africa’s resilience…
item.description: First Gentleman Epafras Ndenga Ndaitwah has called for stronger, people-centred institutions to build Africa’s resilience. He was addressing the 30th session of the Organisation of African First Ladies for Development in Addis Ababa today. He stressed the need for community-level resources, early climate warning systems and locally-driven solutions while urging protection and opportunities for all....

item.title: Suicide…
item.description: A 90-year-old man allegedly committed suicide last night at Omapumba village in Ohangwena region. Ohangwena Nampol Deputy Commissioner Melanie Mburu confirmed the incident. No suicide note was found at the scene.Photo: Heather Erdmann
